answers.core: This makes setting up the Movie Maker mode more convenient, without requiring the user to write a script. This can improve the feature's accessibility to artists.
answers.workaround:
Yes, by attaching the following script to the AnimationPlayer node that governs the main action (such as camera movement):

```gdscript
extends AnimationPlayer


func _on_animation_player_animation_finished(_anim_name):
	if OS.has_feature("movie"):
		print("Done recording movie.")
		get_tree().quit()
```

The animation must **not** be set to loop. Otherwise, the `animation_finished` signal will never be emitted.

title: Add a property to quit the engine when an animation is done playing in Movie Maker mode
